description.value: Choices Market is a 100% BC-owned and operated natural and specialty grocery chain that has been serving communities since 1990, with locations from Kitsilano to Kelowna. The Yaletown location on Richards Street stocks local, organic, and specialty food items, and offers free personalized nutrition tours with on-staff dietitians and holistic nutritionists. For touring cyclists, it provides a full-service grocery stop in the heart of Vancouver with a wide range of health-focused and specialty dietary products.
